settings.question: How do I place an order on your website?
settings.answer:
To place an order at BombaySutra, follow these simple steps:

  1. Browse through our ethnic wear collection and select your favorite product.
  2. Choose the size and quantity you wish to order.
  3. Click on “Add to Cart.”
  4. A side window will appear with your cart summary and a “Checkout” button.
  5. Click on “Checkout” to fill in your delivery and payment details.

    Once your payment is confirmed, you’ll receive an email with your order details and tracking information.

settings.question: I have a promo code, how do I apply it?
settings.answer:
You can apply your promo code on the Shipping Page, after entering your customer details.

On the right-hand side, you’ll see a box labeled “Discount code” — enter your code there and click “Apply.” Your discount will be automatically reflected in the total before you complete payment.

settings.question: What payment methods are accepted at BombaySutra?
settings.answer:
We accept all major credit and debit cards, as well as digital payment methods like:

  • Net Banking
  • UPI
  • Paytm
  • Google Pay
  • PhonePe
  • and other secure online payment options.

All transactions on our website are 100% safe and encrypted.

settings.question: What are the shipping charges for an order?
settings.answer: We offer free shipping across India on all orders placed through our official website.

settings.question: Do you accept returns?
settings.answer:
We currentlydo not accept returnsonce an order is placed, as each piece is made and packed with care.
